plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Film Studies Certificate' program map, Catalog 2025-26, published July 23, 2025 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/6880/PublishedPdf). This is a Certificate of Achievement (a grade of C or better is required in each course). Official Total Units: 15-18 = 9+6 = 15 at the low end, verified against the map's 9-12 / 6 headers. All courses are categorized as major electives (the map lists every course as ME - Major Elective). The modeled path uses the first-listed options at the low end of variable units: TAFILM 300 for Introduction to Film (alternative: ENGLT 400); TAFILM 302 (3 units) for the Semester 1 *Major Elective slot (documented alternative: the TAFILM 303 & TAFILM 304 combination, which is 6 units and is what drives the 9-12 header range); ENGLT 403 (3 units) for the Semester 1 **Major Elective slot (choose 3 units of the 9-unit list); MUSM 322 and TAFILM 307 (3 units each) for the Semester 2 *Major Elective slots (choose 6 units of the 9-unit list not already completed in a previous semester, so distinct courses). Prerequisite noted in the map: TAFILM 332 requires TAFILM 330 with a grade of C or better (applies only if TAFILM 332 is selected; the modeled picks are ENGLT 403, MUSM 322, TAFILM 307, so no prereq applies in-plan). tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
